subject: english
title: Unit 6 Grammar 1
subtitle: Obligation and prohibition — have to, must, can't and don't, from the Grammar Workbook chart.

content: Say what people have to and must do to protect the ocean.
Say what people can't do, and give a direct rule with Don't.
Sort ten Student Book sentences into obligation and prohibition.
language: Use have to, must, can't and don't with the base verb.
Choose has to for third-person singular subjects.
Recognise that must is stronger and more formal than have to.
